title: Sit & Stay Basics
description: Learn the first command every dog should know. Use good reward timing.
steps: Hold a treat close to your dog's nose
Move your hand up so the head follows and the bottom lowers
Say 'sit' once the bottom touches the ground and reward immediately
Repeat 5–10 times per session, twice a day

title: Loose-Leash Walking
description: Teach your dog to walk next to you without pulling.
steps: Start in a low-distraction space like your hallway
Stop walking the instant the leash goes tight
Reward and continue only when the leash slackens again
Gradually add outdoor distractions once mastered indoors

title: Puppy Toilet Training
description: A simple routine that builds good bathroom habits in a few weeks.
steps: Take your puppy out first thing, after meals, and after naps
Choose one consistent outdoor spot and cue word
Reward within 3 seconds of successful elimination outside
Clean indoor accidents with an enzymatic cleaner to remove scent

title: Positive Reinforcement 101
description: The main training idea behind every FurEver Care lesson.
steps: Mark the exact desired behavior with a clicker or the word 'yes'
Follow the marker with a reward within 1–2 seconds
Fade treats gradually and replace with praise and play
Never use punishment — redirect unwanted behavior instead
